notes: Statement change, equivalent: the hypotheses `Submodule.IsLattice K M` inside the Prop definitions TraceReal, GenusCovol and GenusScale become `Submodule.IsFullLattice K M`. The module compiles unchanged, but Mathlib #44365 renamed the pinned `IsLattice` (finitely generated and spanning) to `IsFullLattice` and reused the name `IsLattice` for a weaker notion without `span_eq_top`, so the unchanged text would silently weaken these definitions; the reused-name audit flagged all three. In each, M is a submodule over `𝓞 K` for a number field `K`, the fraction field of `𝓞 K`, so `IsFullLattice K M ↔ M.FG ∧ span K M = ⊤`, which is the pinned definition, because `Submodule.IsLattice.of_fg` supplies the new field. No hypothesis is added or removed.
